notes.title: Triple Take is a game of the saying “third time’s the charm” – but the third time might just cause some rage quits this time
notes.notes:
Finland biggest publisher Bonus Stage Publishing (That's us, yey) today announced Triple Take: a game by FlyAway found its way to their portfolio. The game will be released in 2022. 

The demo is already available on Steam.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734250

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/cf3eddeeff2922ebb1d02fc717e994d92a883a17.gif[/img]

Triple Take is a series of unexpected experiences in the form of a fast 2D precision platformer where the level evolves as you complete it! Run, wall jump, climb and swim through increasingly difficult levels in (un)vibrantly colored worlds! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37611909/ba6e8606ffab44e3c9d11140963f44d7e722b7c8.jpg[/img]

When you start any level for the first time, it might seem to be almost too easy to beat, but the levels evolve when you play further. Every time you beat any level, the level changes somehow and you need to play it again. Three times. Triple Take. Ok, you got it. This makes completing levels… difficult. Jumps become more difficult, new threats reveal themselves, and new pathways open up! Difficult.

notes.title: The Last Soul sees the light of the day in 2022 by Bonus Stage Publishing
notes.notes:
Last Soul is an action-packed shooting platformer headlining BOP, the last remaining soul on earth fighting against Cyber-Being. You play as the cute but powerful BOP and in addition to all the regular mechanics, your jetpack, shields, and bullet time pack some real punch against the evil forces trying to destroy even the last of the remaining souls.

The vast world of Last Soul is inspired by Star Wars, Tron Legacy, Mario, Sonic and Megaman, Neon Abyss, and all that can be seen in the graphics and felt in the soundtrack. The perfectly sci-fi-retro music is balanced with an equally great story. 

"I took the time to study the 'Hero with a thousand faces' (by Joseph Campbell) and set the basis for my game story. The Last Soul includes a hero which is moved to an adventure that he doesn't want; a closing partner that he needs to achieve his destiny; a powerful enemy with a basic conflict with the hero; a master that teaches the hero the truth; and many other equally important elements", tells Tony Munoz, the lead developer of WULUM, the Canadian studio behind Last Soul.

[previewyoutube=apKCFSTq4sw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The game is soon to be launched on Kickstarter for pre-orders and early fan bonuses. The campaign is set to start in October, with pre-registration open now. There are almost 600 pre-registered fans waiting, and nearly 20,000 players in the Last Soul prologue.

The game will be launched in Q2/2022 and will come out on all major platforms. The publisher is the still fresh name from Finland, Bonus Stage Publishing. Bonus Stage has also published Sunblaze in June 2021, which is as well a game that goes well with speedrunners, just like Last Soul.

The game will be a perfect addition to their portfolio according to Sami Mikkola from Bonus Stage: "When we first saw Last Soul, the immediate reaction from all of us was 'WE NEED TO HAVE THIS'. The cuteness, retro sci-fi setting, and its unique but tough-as-nails gameplay were just immediate Yes' from us."

Last Soul is just about to open up on Kickstarter, and is already ready to be wishlisted & followed on Steam.

notes.title: July starts with new light and dark levels
notes.notes:
During the last weeks, we prepared new Pixelarts for LAST SOUL. Now, that summer is on its way, we're setting all the content on different types of scenes while playing with light and color.

The story of LAST SOUL is about a perfect place for humans. So we want to present that image in the world that we're creating. But at the same time, we also want to play with light and dark scenes to make your experience as rich as possible.

We're exchanging comments and ideas with LAST SOUL fans using our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/wulumgames][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB][b]Discord[/b][/url]). According to the trending preference, they'd like to play on different types of scenes with different types of light. So, you'll get that, guys!

Our most important goal related to Pixelart is to avoid using Tiles as much a possible. We wish scenarios changing with every level and that you feel you are in a different place when you start a new one. Achieving this goal is not an easy trick, but we understand their implications in terms of the gamer's experience and we accepted the challenge.

Get connected to our social media to keep you updated on recent changes. As always, we want to listen to your suggestions to improve the game to the highest level. Starting in July this year, we'll be full speed creating new content for our game that you'll enjoy. Also, we're preparing these levels to be presented on new events and demos of the game that you'll enjoy.

[previewyoutube=DY9pg9p_IQk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Call you friends! Over 2500 and counting!
notes.notes:
During the last three months, we divided our working time between developing our game and building an amazing community of fans. The results are here.

For the Prologue of Last Soul, we distributed more than 10,000 licenses in less than 8 days. For an Indie with no current publisher support, these numbers are huge. Now, after three months promoting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1566040/Last_Soul/]final release of Last Soul[/url] we have 2,500 wishlists and incrementing every day. Thanks for that amazing support.

Now our compromise is even bigger. That's why during the last weeks we've been creating more features that you'll enjoy in the final version. More will come in a few days.

Every day we're posting updates on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url][/b] channel. On May 10th, we got over 500 followers. Today, we have 600 and counting. What can be a better prove for ourselves that our fans are in love with BOP and his adventures? Nevertheless, we're still in need of your support.

The process of getting funding has been challenging. But because many of you had suggested it, we're preparing a Kickstarter campaign to release in a few months. This last month we prepared all content for the campaign and next week we'll work on the first video. We'll keep you informed about it so you can bring us your support by following our campaign. We know we count on you.

[previewyoutube=Pk6Ar3cmzDs;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, we'll appreciate your support in spreading the word about the game. Tell your mom, grandpa, friends, and everyone you love. We need as many Wishlist clicks as possible. And please don't forget to join our Mail List on [b][url=https://www.wulum.com]wulum.com[/url][/b] to grant you access to Alpha, Betas, and new gifts we're preparing for our subscribers.

Again, THANK YOU.

Tony Munoz
Creator / Head of Dev Team - Wulum

notes.title: Two new scenes' art and heading to next coding phase.
notes.notes:
Six months ago we released the prototype of "LAST SOUL." It was a basic concept showing a lot of potentials. We know that the features were good but also that our PixelArt style needed a lot of work.

After our Prologue Demo Release at the end of January, we realized that people were in love with the new PixelArt look. That gave us the reasons to continue and pushing our limits for the next levels.

During this week we were working live on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wulum]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://bit.ly/2VbfF4n]YouTube[/url] channels with our followers. While we perform PixelArt we listening to their suggestions and ideas to improve it. Great suggestions of colors, effects, and elements were created. Now, we're heading to the next phase of our game.

Currently, we have PixelArt elements for another three sections of our game. "LAST SOUL" includes different scenarios where you will confront different challenges. For the next week, we plan to move forward setting all elements together (including coding). In a few weeks, we'll be able to present the definitive version of the Prologue of our game heading to the final version.

Discover what is our new art and be part of our creation process following our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wulum]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://bit.ly/2VbfF4n]YouTube[/url]. Remember to join our [url=https://www.wulum.com]Mail List[/url] to access Alpha and Betas of the final version. Be part of our [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url] and the conversations we're having with our fans. And don't forget to spread the word about this amazing game we're creating with you.

notes.title: Moving to our Flying City
notes.notes:
LAST SOUL development is not about creating a game alone in a basement. It's about sharing the process with the entire world.

When we decided to start this game, we wanted everyone looking what we're doing so they can give us immediate feedback about our game and suggestions to improve it as we progress.

During the last couple of weeks, we prepared and created a bunch of buildings representing the Flying City of our game scenario. We created the background and the buildings you'll interact with. But this is just one scenario of many to come.

We have an important artistic goal on LAST SOUL. We want our PixelArt to be amazing. That's why we have people in charge of the Concept Art and then of translating that to PixelArt.

Enjoy the images of our progress on our social media, [url=https://discord.gg/TaAVqT9paB]Discord[/url], and join our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wulum]Twitch[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3rRLtI9Q2J4&t=219s]YouTube[/url] channel to post your suggestions LIVE on this wonderful process.
